summary_hint: FEMA flood determination for <property_address>: Zone <flood_zone>, SFHA <yes/no>, NFIP community <name>/<number>, panel <map_panel_number>, determined <determination_date> by <determination_company_name> — the zone IH-5 needs and the SFHA flag IH-6 keys on.

typed_core.name: flood_zone
typed_core.why: IH-5 (rule reads it) — the zone to extract; IH-6 reads it to detect Zone A/V (SFHA)
typed_core.prompt_hint: SFHA zones are A/AE/AO/AH/AR/A99 and V/VE; X/B/C/D are not SFHA. The flood_zone value disambiguates the SFHA indicator

typed_core.name: special_flood_hazard_area_indicator
typed_core.why: IH-6 (rule reads it) — the authoritative SFHA yes/no that triggers the flood-policy check
typed_core.prompt_hint: The SFHA indicator is authoritative for IH-6; if it conflicts with the flood_zone, surface for review rather than deriving SFHA from the zone alone

typed_core.name: property_address
typed_core.why: identity — which property the determination covers; IH-5/IH-6 attribution to the subject

typed_core.name: property_description_or_parcel
typed_core.why: disambiguator for property_address — legal description / parcel when the street address is ambiguous or absent

typed_core.name: federal_flood_insurance_available
typed_core.why: processor / IH-6 context — whether NFIP coverage is available (regular vs emergency program vs not participating)
typed_core.prompt_hint: CBRA/OPA can void federal flood insurance availability even inside an SFHA — capture coastal_barrier_or_opa_indicator alongside this

typed_core.name: coastal_barrier_or_opa_indicator
typed_core.why: disambiguator for IH-6 — a CBRA/OPA property may be in an SFHA yet have NO federal flood insurance available, changing the required action

typed_core.name: nfip_community_name
typed_core.why: identity — the community; disambiguates the zone (zones are per community/panel)

typed_core.name: nfip_community_number
typed_core.why: identity/disambiguator — NFIP community id; with the panel it authenticates the zone read

typed_core.name: county
typed_core.why: identity/disambiguator — locates the community/panel; aids property matching

typed_core.name: map_panel_number
typed_core.why: disambiguator for flood_zone — the zone is read off a specific FIRM panel; the panel id anchors it
typed_core.prompt_hint: Capture the full FIRM panel identifier (community number + panel number + suffix) and the map effective/revised date together — the zone is only trustworthy against a specific map version

typed_core.name: map_panel_suffix
typed_core.why: disambiguator — the suffix letter completes the FIRM panel identifier

typed_core.name: map_effective_or_revised_date
typed_core.why: disambiguator — which FIRM map version produced the zone; recency of the map

typed_core.name: determination_date
typed_core.why: IH-5/identity — when the determination was made; recency / life-of-loan currency

typed_core.name: determination_company_name
typed_core.why: identity — who made the determination (third-party independence)

typed_core.name: determination_identifier
typed_core.why: identity — determination / tracking number for cross-document matching

typed_core.name: determination_method_or_source
typed_core.why: disambiguator — how the zone was determined (map read vs LOMA/LOMR letter), which affects trust in the zone

typed_core.name: lender_name_and_address
typed_core.why: identity/attribution — links the determination to the lender/loan

typed_core.name: lender_id_or_loan_number
typed_core.why: identity — links to the loan file (confidential)

typed_core.name: borrower_name
typed_core.why: identity — attaches the determination to the borrower

typed_core.name: life_of_loan_tracking_indicator
typed_core.why: processor/compliance — whether life-of-loan monitoring was ordered

typed_core.name: form_number
typed_core.why: identity/disambiguator — confirms the standard FEMA SFHDF (Form 086-0-32) vs a vendor variant
typed_core.prompt_hint: This is the FEMA Standard Flood Hazard Determination Form (SFHDF, FEMA Form 086-0-32) or a vendor equivalent — expect NFIP community, FIRM map panel + suffix + effective date, flood zone, SFHA yes/no, and federal-insurance-availability boxes

typed_core.name: comments_or_manual_review
typed_core.why: processor — manual-review notes (e.g. 'structure outside SFHA though parcel touches') that are material to IH-6

rejected.name: form_revision_date
rejected.reason: form_number is enough to identify the SFHDF; revision date marginal, catch-all

rejected.name: issuer_name
rejected.reason: duplicates determination_company_name (the issuer is the determination vendor)

rejected.name: effective_date, expiration_date
rejected.reason: a flood determination is life-of-loan and does not 'expire'; would duplicate map/determination dates

rejected.name: statement_period_start, statement_period_end
rejected.reason: not applicable to a flood determination

rejected.name: party_names, party_addresses
rejected.reason: covered by flattened borrower_name + lender_name_and_address + determination_company_name

rejected.name: signature_blocks, preparer_signature_or_certification
rejected.reason: flood determinations are commonly system-generated/unsigned; no rule; authenticity is marginal here — catch-all

encoding_variations: flood_zone — stated many ways: A, AE, AO, AH, AR, A99, V, VE (all SFHA) vs X, X (shaded), B, C, D (non-SFHA / undetermined). Some certs write 'Zone AE' and some just 'AE'. IH-6's SFHA set is A/AE/AO/AH/AR/A99/V/VE.
special_flood_hazard_area_indicator — a boolean with no coercer; appears as Yes/No, Y/N, an X in a 'IN SFHA' box, or 'OUT'. Degraded to str; the prompt must normalize.
federal_flood_insurance_available — 'regular program', 'emergency program', 'not participating', 'NSFHA'. Degraded from boolean to str; carries more than yes/no.
coastal_barrier_or_opa_indicator — CBRA / OPA designation; often blank when not applicable. Degraded to str.
map_panel_number + map_panel_suffix — the full FIRM panel id is panel number + suffix letter (e.g. 48201C 0805 L); some certs print them together, some in separate boxes. Keep both.

open_questions.q: Boolean degradation — special_flood_hazard_area_indicator, federal_flood_insurance_available, coastal_barrier_or_opa_indicator, and life_of_loan_tracking_indicator all degrade to str (no boolean coercer). IH-6 must interpret 'Y'/'Yes'/'X'/checkbox.
options: keep str + a prompt hint to emit normalized yes/no
open_questions.recommendation: (a) now, flag (b) as a candidate coercer since flood SFHA is a hard yes/no gate

open_questions.q: Zone-vs-indicator authority — if flood_zone implies SFHA (e.g. AE) but the SFHA indicator says 'OUT' (structure outside the mapped SFHA), which does IH-6 read?
open_questions.recommendation: the SFHA indicator is the field IH-6 reads; flood_zone is the disambiguator; conflicts surface for review

open_questions.q: Both rules BLOCKED — IH-5 and IH-6 are status BLOCKED (no producer yet). Confirm the schema should still land flood_zone and the SFHA indicator now so the rules light up when unblocked.
open_questions.recommendation: yes — rule-floor-first; landing them now avoids the value going to the discarded catch-all later

open_questions.q: comments_or_manual_review as free text — partial-SFHA nuance ('structure outside SFHA though parcel touches') is material to IH-6 but arrives as prose.
options: later add a structured partial-SFHA flag/tag
open_questions.recommendation: (a); flag a potential tag for the reviewer

notes: 22 typed-core rows — within the 20-25 target. The two rules key on just two fields (flood_zone, SFHA indicator); the remainder are the FIRM/NFIP disambiguators those two fields need to be trusted, plus identity and processor fields.
Both IH-5 and IH-6 are currently status BLOCKED (no producer yet); the fields must still land now (rule-floor-first) so the rules activate when unblocked.

No new _PII_FIELDS registration proposed. borrower_name is standard sensitivity; lender_id_or_loan_number is confidential but a loan identifier, not a maskable PII kind; property_address is the subject collateral (widely known), promoted to typed core for identity, not masking. If a determination ever carries the borrower's separate mailing address or any SSN, add it as a named typed field and register, never leave to the unmasked catch-all.
Ambiguity: determination_date is marked 'IH-5/identity' — classed identity (when the determination was made / recency) with IH-5 carried in rules; a defensible alternative is reason_class rule.
